newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moonstone says finds marine diamonds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moonstone says finds marine diamonds.

text.p: Marine diamond hunter Moonstone Diamond Corp said on Wednesday it has recovered 376 diamonds off the coast of South Africa.
The diamonds, weighing a total of 127.29 carats, were recovered during equipment trial work up to January 24, the company said.
The largest of the stones weighed 2.379 carats, Moonstone said.
Moonstone is exploring the sea floor near the mouth of the Orange River in South Africa jointly with Benguela Concessions Ltd.
Using a specially-equipped vessel, Moonstone said it hopes production will total about 65,000 gem-quality carats a year.
